vision.en: The bus turns onto the bridge.

wake.en: You open your eyes. You are at the bus stop. The bus is just pulling in.
wake.tr: Gözünü açıyorsun. Duraktasın. Otobüs daha yeni geliyor.
wake.pl: Otwierasz oczy. Stoisz na przystanku. Autobus właśnie podjeżdża.

text.en: “Getting on or not?” You just watched this bus fall off the bridge. It hasn't happened yet.
text.tr: “Binmiyor musun?” Az önce bu otobüsün köprüden düştüğünü gördün. Daha düşmedi.
text.pl: „Wsiada pan czy nie?” Przed chwilą widziałeś, jak ten autobus spada z mostu. To jeszcze się nie stało.

after.en: Most of them laugh. A girl in a yellow coat gets off and walks over: Elif.
after.tr: Çoğu sana güldü. Sarı montlu bir kız inip yanına geldi: Elif.
after.pl: Większość się śmieje. Dziewczyna w żółtej kurtce wysiada i podchodzi: Elif.

after.en: The doors close. The bus turns the corner.
after.tr: Kapılar kapandı. Otobüs köşeyi döndü.
after.pl: Drzwi się zamykają. Autobus znika za rogiem.

text.en: Sirens from the direction of the bridge. Your hands are shaking.
text.tr: Köprü tarafından siren sesleri geliyor. Elin titriyor.
text.pl: Od strony mostu słychać syreny. Trzęsą ci się ręce.

after.en: The sirens fade. Everything feels a little further away.
after.tr: Sesler kesildi. Her şey biraz uzaklaştı.
after.pl: Syreny cichną. Wszystko wydaje się trochę dalej.

after.en: The bridge on your screen. The bus in the water. You pocket your earbuds.
after.tr: Ekranda köprü. Otobüs suda. Kulaklıkları cebine attın.
after.pl: Most na ekranie. Autobus w wodzie. Chowasz słuchawki do kieszeni.

text.en: Your hand shakes and coffee spills onto your shoe. The waiter wipes the floor.
text.tr: Elin titrerken kahve ayakkabına döküldü. Garson yeri siliyor.
text.pl: Drży ci ręka i kawa wylewa się na but. Kelner wyciera podłogę.

after.en: Five minutes in the chair. Your breathing slows.
after.tr: Beş dakika oturdun. Nefesin düzeldi.
after.pl: Pięć minut na krześle. Oddech się uspokaja.

after.en: This place isn't safe either. You walk out.
after.tr: Burası da güvenli değil. Dışarı çıktın.
after.pl: Tu też nie jest bezpiecznie. Wychodzisz.

text.en: “How did you know? Is anything else going to happen today?”
text.tr: “Bunu nereden bildin? Bugün başka bir şey de olacak mı?”
text.pl: „Skąd wiedziałeś? Czy dzisiaj stanie się coś jeszcze?”

after.en: She doesn't laugh. She asks for your number.
after.tr: Gülmedi. Numaranı istedi.
after.pl: Nie śmieje się. Prosi o twój numer.

after.en: She doesn't believe you. She takes your number anyway.
after.tr: İnanmadı. Yine de numaranı aldı.
after.pl: Nie wierzy ci. Mimo to bierze twój numer.

text.en: The light is red and the road looks empty. Someone is running toward you from behind.
text.tr: Işık kırmızı, yol boş. Arkandan biri sana doğru koşuyor.
text.pl: Światło jest czerwone, droga wygląda na pustą. Ktoś biegnie w twoją stronę.

after.en: The man hands you the keys you dropped. You are too scared to laugh.
after.tr: Adam düşürdüğün anahtarlığı uzattı. Korkudan gülemedin.
after.pl: Mężczyzna podaje ci upuszczone klucze. Ze strachu nie umiesz się zaśmiać.

after.en: A truck misses you by a hand. The horn rings in your ears.
after.tr: Bir kamyon kıl payı geçti. Korna kulağında çınlıyor.
after.pl: Ciężarówka mija cię o włos. Klakson dzwoni ci w uszach.

text.en: Twelfth floor. The elevator creaks. The stairs were just mopped.
text.tr: On ikinci kat. Asansör gıcırdıyor, merdivenler yeni yıkanmış.
text.pl: Dwunaste piętro. Winda skrzypi. Schody właśnie umyto.

after.en: Twelve floors. Your legs shake, but you made it.
after.tr: On iki kat. Bacakların titriyor ama yukarıdasın.
after.pl: Dwanaście pięter. Nogi ci drżą, ale jesteś na górze.

after.en: The doors close. The light flickers once. Nothing happens.
after.tr: Kapılar kapandı, ışık bir kez gitti geldi. Hiçbir şey olmadı.
after.pl: Drzwi się zamykają. Światło raz mruga. Nic się nie dzieje.

text.en: Your keys are gone. A neighbour opens up: “The balconies touch. You can climb across.”
text.tr: Anahtarın yok. Komşu kapıyı açtı: “Balkonlar bitişik, geçebilirsin.”
text.pl: Nie masz kluczy. Sąsiad otwiera drzwi: „Balkony się stykają. Możesz przejść.”

after.en: Two hours on the stairs. Boring, but you are alive.
after.tr: İki saat merdivende oturdun. Sıkıcı, ama hayattasın.
after.pl: Dwie godziny na schodach. Nudno, ale żyjesz.

text.en: You haven't eaten all day.

after.en: You light the stove. The oil starts to warm.
after.tr: Ocağı yaktın. Yağ ısınmaya başladı.
after.pl: Zapalasz kuchenkę. Olej zaczyna się grzać.

after.en: Your stomach cramps, but the stove stays off.
after.tr: Midene kramp girdi ama ocak kapalı.
after.pl: Skręca ci żołądek, ale kuchenka jest wyłączona.

text.en: She saw the news. “Are you all right? Please pick up!”
text.tr: Haberleri görmüş. “Sen iyi misin? Ne olur aç!”
text.pl: Widziała wiadomości. „Nic ci nie jest? Proszę, odbierz!”

after.en: You talk for twenty minutes. Both of you cry.
after.tr: Yirmi dakika konuştunuz. İkiniz de ağladınız.
after.pl: Rozmawiacie dwadzieścia minut. Oboje płaczecie.

after.en: Stove off. When you call back, her voice is shaking.
after.tr: Ocağı kapattın. Geri aradığında sesi titriyordu.
after.pl: Kuchenka wyłączona. Gdy oddzwaniasz, jej głos drży.

text.en: A burning smell. The pan is on fire and the flames reach for the hood.
text.tr: Yanık kokusu. Tava alev almış, alev davlumbaza uzanıyor.
text.pl: Swąd spalenizny. Patelnia płonie, ogień sięga okapu.

label.en: Cover it, turn off the gas

after.en: The flame chokes out. Your hand is burned, but the flat survives.
after.tr: Alev boğuldu. Elin yandı ama ev duruyor.
after.pl: Płomień gaśnie. Masz poparzoną rękę, ale mieszkanie ocalało.

text.en: You haven't slept since last night. Your eyes keep closing.
text.tr: Dün geceden beri uyumadın. Gözlerin kapanıyor.
text.pl: Nie spałeś od wczoraj. Oczy same ci się zamykają.

after.en: You dream about the bridge. It still helps.
after.tr: Rüyanda köprüyü gördün. Yine de iyi geldi.
after.pl: Śni ci się most. Mimo to pomaga.

after.en: You make coffee and watch the ceiling.
after.tr: Kahve yaptın. Tavanı izliyorsun.
after.pl: Robisz kawę i patrzysz w sufit.

text.en: “The other man who got off the bus is dead. In an elevator. Is that a coincidence? Should I come over?”
text.tr: “Otobüsten inen diğer adam öldü. Asansörde. Bu tesadüf mü? Yanına geleyim mi?”
text.pl: „Ten drugi facet, który wysiadł z autobusu, nie żyje. W windzie. To przypadek? Mam przyjść?”

text.en: “The other man who got off the bus is dead. In an elevator. Are we next? I'm coming over.”
text.tr: “Otobüsten inen diğer adam öldü. Asansörde. Sıra bizde mi? Yanına geliyorum.”
text.pl: „Ten drugi facet, który wysiadł z autobusu, nie żyje. W windzie. Czy my jesteśmy następni? Już idę.”

after.en: Half an hour later she is at your door.
after.tr: Yarım saat sonra kapındaydı.
after.pl: Pół godziny później stoi w twoich drzwiach.

after.en: Read. No reply.
after.tr: Görüldü. Cevap yok.
after.pl: Odczytano. Brak odpowiedzi.

text.en: “This is the police. Cameras show you leaving the stop. We need your statement.”
text.tr: “Polisten arıyoruz. Duraktan uzaklaştığınız görüntülerde var. İfadenize ihtiyacımız var.”
text.pl: „Tu policja. Kamery pokazują, jak odchodzi pan z przystanku. Potrzebujemy pana zeznań.”

after.en: The officer takes a note. Your palms are wet when you hang up.
after.tr: Polis not aldı. Kapatınca ellerin terlemişti.
after.pl: Policjant notuje. Gdy się rozłączasz, masz mokre dłonie.

after.en: The phone goes quiet. The silence is worse.
after.tr: Telefon sustu. Sessizlik daha kötü.
after.pl: Telefon cichnie. Cisza jest gorsza.

text.en: The power is out. The box is in the hallway and the floor is damp.
text.tr: Elektrikler gitti. Kutu koridorda, zemin rutubetli.
text.pl: Nie ma prądu. Skrzynka jest w korytarzu, a podłoga jest wilgotna.

after.en: Elif holds up a torch. “Stop, that wire is bare!” You press the right switch.
after.tr: Elif fenerle tuttu: “Dur, o kablo çıplak!” Doğru düğmeye bastın.
after.pl: Elif świeci latarką. „Stój, ten kabel jest goły!” Naciskasz właściwy przełącznik.

after.en: An hour later the lights come back on their own.
after.tr: Bir saat sonra ışıklar kendiliğinden geldi.
after.pl: Godzinę później światło wraca samo.

text.en: She is on the balcony, leaning on the railing. Was that railing always this loose?
text.tr: Balkonda hava alıyor, korkuluğa yaslanmış. O korkuluk sallanıyor muydu?
text.pl: Stoi na balkonie, oparta o barierkę. Czy ta barierka zawsze się tak chwiała?

after.en: She glares and steps in. A moment later the railing drops into the dark.
after.tr: Kızdı, içeri girdi. Tam o an korkuluk boşluğa düştü.
after.pl: Patrzy ze złością i wchodzi. Chwilę później barierka spada w ciemność.

text.en: Someone knocks. Nobody in the peephole. The heavy wardrobe stands beside you.
text.tr: Kapı çalındı. Gözetlikte kimse yok. Yanında ağır gardırop duruyor.
text.pl: Ktoś puka. W wizjerze nikogo nie ma. Obok ciebie stoi ciężka szafa.

after.en: Nobody. On the mat lies this morning's bus ticket.
after.tr: Kimse yok. Paspasta sabahki otobüsün bileti var.
after.pl: Nikogo. Na wycieraczce leży poranny bilet autobusowy.

text.en: You never heard the truck.
You wanted to escape the sirens
You put your earbuds in
You thought someone was chasing you
You crossed on red
You didn't hear the horn

hint.en: Without earbuds, you would have heard the horn.

text.en: On the seventh floor your foot slipped. Empty air. That's all.
text.tr: Yedinci katta ayağın kaydı. Boşluk. Hepsi bu.
text.pl: Na siódmym piętrze poślizgnęła ci się noga. Pustka. To wszystko.

text.en: Your hand shook
Coffee spilled on your shoe
You didn't wait for it to dry
You chose the stairs
Wet sole, freshly mopped step

hint.en: Five minutes in the café would have dried your shoe. The elevator was safe today.
hint.tr: Kafede beş dakika otursaydın ayakkabın kururdu. Asansör bugün güvenliydi.
hint.pl: Pięć minut w kawiarni i but by wysechł. Winda była dziś bezpieczna.

text.en: The gap was wider than it looked.
text.pl: Szczelina była szersza, niż się wydawało.

text.en: You ran on red
You didn't notice your keys were gone
You were locked out
You listened to your neighbour
Twelfth floor

hint.en: The man running behind you was bringing your keys.
hint.pl: Biegnący za tobą mężczyzna niósł twoje klucze.

text.en: The moment water hit the oil, fire leapt to the ceiling.
text.tr: Su yağa değdiği an alev tavana çıktı.
text.pl: Gdy woda dotknęła oleju, ogień skoczył pod sufit.

text.en: You heated oil for an egg
Your mum called
You forgot the stove
The oil caught fire
You poured water on it

hint.en: Water makes an oil fire explode. Covering the pan would have smothered it.
hint.tr: Yağ yangını suyla sönmez, patlar. Kapağı kapatmalıydın.
hint.pl: Woda sprawia, że płonący olej wybucha. Trzeba było przykryć patelnię.

text.en: In the dark, you touched the wrong place.
text.pl: W ciemności dotknąłeś nie tego miejsca.

text.en: You didn't ask Elif to come
You saved nobody, so you were alone
text.pl: Nikogo nie uratowałeś, więc byłeś sam

text.en: The power went out
You didn't want to wait
Damp floor, bare wire

hint.en: Someone holding a torch would have seen that wire.
hint.tr: Yanında fener tutan biri olsaydı kabloyu görürdü.
hint.pl: Ktoś z latarką zauważyłby ten kabel.

text.en: You hugged her. The railing couldn't hold you both.
text.pl: Przytuliłeś ją. Barierka nie utrzymała was obojga.

text.en: You saved Elif
You asked her to come
You got through the night together
You relaxed
You stepped onto the balcony

hint.en: You could have risked her anger and called her inside.
hint.tr: Kızmasını göze alıp onu içeri çağırabilirdin.
hint.pl: Mogłeś zaryzykować jej złość i zawołać ją do środka.

text.en: Guarding the door, you pulled the wardrobe down on yourself.
text.pl: Pilnując drzwi, przewróciłeś na siebie szafę.

text.en: You spent the whole day alone
Someone knocked
You panicked
You pulled a heavy wardrobe alone

hint.en: There was nobody at the door. Sometimes death only scares you.
hint.tr: Kapıda kimse yoktu. Ölüm bazen sadece korkutur.
hint.pl: Za drzwiami nikogo nie było. Śmierć czasem tylko straszy.

text.en: You stopped in the middle of a street and couldn't walk on. You never saw the cyclist.
text.tr: Bir yolun ortasında durdun, yürüyemedin. Bisikletliyi görmedin.
text.pl: Zatrzymałeś się na środku ulicy i nie mogłeś iść dalej. Nie zauważyłeś rowerzysty.

text.en: You never calmed down
You suspected everything
You couldn't decide anymore

hint.en: Before 🧠 hits zero, take the chances to breathe: sit, sleep, talk.
hint.tr: 🧠 sıfıra inmeden nefes alma fırsatlarını kullan: oturmak, uyumak, konuşmak.
hint.pl: Zanim 🧠 spadnie do zera, łap chwile oddechu: usiądź, prześpij się, porozmawiaj.

text.en: In the kitchen your head spun, and the counter's corner was very close.
text.tr: Mutfakta başın döndü, tezgâhın köşesi çok yakındı.
text.pl: W kuchni zakręciło ci się w głowie, a róg blatu był bardzo blisko.

text.en: You didn't eat or rest
You pushed yourself too hard
Your body gave up

hint.en: When ❤️ drops, food and sleep will save you.
hint.tr: ❤️ düşerken yemek ve uyku seni kurtarır.
hint.pl: Gdy ❤️ spada, ratują cię jedzenie i sen.

text.en: You fell. You shouted for hours. There was nobody left to call you.
text.tr: Düştün. Saatlerce bağırdın. Seni arayacak kimse kalmamıştı.
text.pl: Upadłeś. Krzyczałeś godzinami. Nie było już nikogo, kto by zadzwonił.

text.en: You pushed people away
You ignored their calls
Nobody came looking

hint.en: If 👥 hits zero, nobody is left to help you.
hint.tr: 👥 sıfıra inerse yardım edecek kimse kalmaz.
hint.pl: Gdy 👥 spadnie do zera, nikt ci nie pomoże.

text.en: 00:00. You are both alive. Elif says nothing. Neither do you. Death missed two people today.
text.tr: 00:00. İkiniz de hayattasınız. Elif bir şey söylemiyor, sen de. Ölüm bugün iki kişiyi kaçırdı.
text.pl: 00:00. Oboje żyjecie. Elif milczy. Ty też. Śmierć przegapiła dziś dwie osoby.

text.en: 00:00. You are alive. You saved nobody today, but you are here. Death got it wrong.
text.tr: 00:00. Hayattasın. Bugün kimseyi kurtaramadın ama buradasın. Ölüm yanıldı.
text.pl: 00:00. Żyjesz. Dziś nikogo nie uratowałeś, ale jesteś tu. Śmierć się pomyliła.

hint.en: There is a better ending, with someone else alive.
hint.tr: Daha iyi bir son var: Başka biri de hayatta kalıyor.
hint.pl: Istnieje lepsze zakończenie: ktoś jeszcze przeżywa.
